channel.title: KubeSphere Ingress Utils on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in KubeSphere Ingress Utils on KubeSphere

item.title: Add Domain Reuse Validation
item.description: This section describes how to use the Route Tool to add domains, so that domain uniqueness validation can be performed when creating or editing an Ingress. Validation Rule: Ingresses under the same gateway can use the same domain and its subdomains. Ingresses under different gateways cannot use the same domain. Note "Domain Reuse Validation" only takes effect for the current cluster and does not apply to previously existing Ingresses.

item.title: View Domain List
item.description: This section describes how to view the list of domains for which "Domain Reuse Validation" is enabled. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Ingress Utils extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-admin permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has cluster-admin permissions and enter your cluster.

item.title: Edit Domain Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit domain information. You can edit the description of a domain. KubeSphere does not support editing the name and domain of an already added domain. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Ingress Utils extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-admin permission in the cluster.

item.title: Delete Domain Name Reuse Validation
item.description: This section describes how to delete a domain name to stop its reuse validation when creating or editing an Ingress. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Ingress Utilss extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-admin permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles.
